agent.name: Melissa Shaw
agent.bioShort: 23 years in West Linn real estate, more than $128 million sold since 2016, and over a thousand buyers and sellers served.
bio: 23 years in real estate, more than $128 million sold since 2016, and over a thousand buyers and sellers. Behind every one of those numbers is a person and a relationship in the middle of a change, and that's the part I actually care about.

I'm detail-oriented, I'm a natural problem-solver, and I negotiate hard. But what fulfills us is fulfilling your needs, and that starts with understanding your desired outcome, personally and financially, before anyone talks about price.

team.name: Tera Harder
team.role: Licensed Real Estate Broker in Oregon
team.bio: Tera puts her heart and soul into every client relationship. Drawing from her background in special education, she brings empathy, patience, and problem-solving to every home search or sale, so clients feel heard, supported, and confident every step of the way.

team.name: Lisa Neef
team.role: Principal Broker in Oregon · Transaction Coordinator
team.bio: Lisa has run her own transaction coordination company since 2013. She manages the documents, deadlines, and details of every purchase and sale so nothing slips and closings stay on track.

team.name: Lora Reed
team.bio: Lora works behind the scenes on the thoughtful touches, from client gifts and moving books to the back-office details, that make every client's experience feel cared for from start to finish.
